narrative: On the plot. The plot on the peg. The title and the hour. No name of a part beside his. On the plot. A paper read at the door and not taken down. One title.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played the afternoon, and brought no part-name away.

entities.name: Richard the Third
entities.context: Shown on plot in The crookback, no name of a side
